title: OpenPhenology species/1
description: One species and every area with a result or within its mapped range.

id.description: The file's path from the API root.

format.description: Format name and version, for example `county-weekly/1.0`.

release.description: The release the file belongs to, such as `2026-10-19`.

gbif_download_dois.description: The GBIF downloads the records came from, as DOIs.

taxonomy.description: The taxonomy version species keys come from.

boundaries.description: The boundary version areas come from.

protection.description: The version of each sensitive-species list applied, by list.

code.description: The commit of the code that produced the file.

run.description: The run that produced the file.

data.description: The content, as the format sets out.

species_key.description: The species key in the shared taxonomy.

authorship.description: The authorship of the scientific name.

common_name.description: The display name, or `null` when there is none.

synonyms.description: Other scientific names, from the shared taxonomy.

level.description: Whether it is a state or a county.

record_dates.description:
How many distinct dates those records fall on; `null` for a species
sensitive in the state. Added in `species/1.10`, so absent from
earlier files.

latest_month.description:
The month of the latest of those records, `YYYY-MM`: when people
recorded it, never whether it is there now. `null` for a species
sensitive in the state. Added in `species/1.10`.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

conditions.description:
Medians over the records the season counts, each on the record's date
at its place (ODR-2026-028). Added in `species/1.7`, so absent from
earlier files.

sunrise.description: Median sunrise, local clock time `HH:MM`, calculated with NOAA's solar calculation.

sunset.description: Median sunset, local clock time `HH:MM`, calculated with NOAA's solar calculation.

high.description: Median daily high in °C, from NOAA nClimGrid-Daily; lower 48 states only.

low.description: Median daily low in °C, from NOAA nClimGrid-Daily; lower 48 states only.

midpoint.description:
Median midpoint of the day's high and low in °C (NOAA's `tavg`); not an
average of temperatures through the day. Lower 48 states only.

windows.description:
When `season_withheld` is `two-seasons`, the two windows its records
split into (data rules `seasonal.md`); otherwise `null`. Added in
`species/1.9`, so absent from earlier files.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

flowering.description:
For a plant, the result from its records that show flowers
(ODR-2026-025); `null` for a species that is not a plant. Added in
`species/1.8`, so absent from earlier files.

records.description: Records that show flowers, counted there.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

windows.description: Its two windows when it is `two-seasons`, or `null`. Added in `species/1.9`.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

fruiting.description:
For a plant, the result from its records that show fruit
(ODR-2026-032); `null` for a species that is not a plant. Added in
`species/1.11`, so absent from earlier files.

records.description: Records that show flowers, counted there.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

windows.description: Its two windows when it is `two-seasons`, or `null`. Added in `species/1.9`.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

adult.description:
For an insect, the result from its records annotated as an adult
(ODR-2026-032); `null` for a species that is not an insect. Added in
`species/1.11`, so absent from earlier files.

records.description: Records that show flowers, counted there.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

windows.description: Its two windows when it is `two-seasons`, or `null`. Added in `species/1.9`.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

larva.description:
For an insect, the result from its records annotated as a larva
(ODR-2026-032); `null` for a species that is not an insect. Pages say
"reported as a caterpillar" for butterflies and moths. Added in
`species/1.11`, so absent from earlier files.

records.description: Records that show flowers, counted there.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

windows.description: Its two windows when it is `two-seasons`, or `null`. Added in `species/1.9`.

season.description: Early, middle and late weeks, or empty.

ranges.description: Every area within its mapped range.

level.description: Whether it is a state or a county.

statuses.description:
The species' listings on government lists: the federal Endangered
Species Act list and Ohio's lists. Empty when it is on none. Added in
`species/1.1`, so absent from `species/1.0` files.

list.description: The list: `usfws` (US Fish & Wildlife Service, Endangered Species Act) or `ohio`.

place.description: Where the list applies: `us` for the federal list, a state code for a state list.

listed_name.description: The scientific name the list gives; it shows when only a subspecies or variety is listed.

status.description: The status, as the list writes it, such as `Endangered`.

where.description: The federal list's own description of where the listing applies, such as `Wherever found`; `null` for a state list.

list_name.description:
The list as the site names it, such as `Ohio's list of endangered and
threatened wild animals`. Added in `species/1.6`, so absent from earlier
files.

keeper.description: Who keeps the list, such as `Ohio Division of Wildlife`. Added in `species/1.6`.

edition.description:
The edition used: the month the federal list was read, such as
`October 2026`, or the state list's own edition, such as `June 2026`.
Added in `species/1.6`.

introductions.description:
The species' US-RIIS listings in the lower 48 states: introduced, or
introduced and assessed as invasive. Empty when it is not listed, which
never means native. Added in `species/1.2`, so absent from earlier files.

source.description:
The list: `us-riis-l48-v2` (US-RIIS ver. 2.0, conterminous 48 states);
from `species/1.12` (ODR-2026-039), `inaturalist-checklist`
(iNaturalist's state checklist, status `introduced` only),
`oh-oda-invasive-plants` (Ohio Department of Agriculture, OAC
901:5-30-01) and `oh-odnr-aquatic-invasive` (ODNR, OAC 1501:31-19-01),
both status `invasive`.

region.description:
Where the listing applies: `us-l48`, the 48 conterminous states and DC;
`us-oh`, Ohio only (from `species/1.12`).

listed_name.description: The scientific name the list gives; it shows when only a subspecies or variety is listed.

status.description: `introduced`, or `invasive`: causing, or likely to cause, harm there.

inaturalist_taxon_id.description:
The species' iNaturalist taxon ID, or `null` when it has none. Added in
`species/1.3`, so absent from earlier files.

photo.description:
The species' photo, or `null` when it has none. Added in `species/1.4`,
so absent from earlier files.

source.description: Where it was chosen from: the default photo, a taxon photo, or an observation photo.

sizes.description: Per role the photo was cut to, the widths made, smallest first.

credit.description: The credit iNaturalist gives, word for word; show it with the photo.

licence.description: The licence's SPDX identifier, such as `CC-BY-NC-4.0`, or `CC0-1.0` or `PDM`.

below_species.description:
Per state with a result, the taxa below species that its records were
identified to: names only, never counts, never per county. Empty when
none of a state's records go below species. Added in `species/1.5`, so
absent from earlier files.

taxa.description: Each subspecies, variety or form with at least 5 of the state's records, by scientific name.

taxon_key.description: The taxon key in the shared taxonomy.

scientific_name.description: The scientific name, with its rank marker, such as `subsp.`.

other_below_species.description: True when other records went below species but their taxon is not listed.
